column2: MAYOR, DEPUTY MAYOR OR A MEMBER OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES

(CHAPTER 262); AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR

column1: INCIDENTAL THERETO.
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Local Authorities Filling

column1: of Vacancies (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013.

column2: For the purpose of filling of a vacancy in the office of

column1: Mayor,  Deputy  Mayor  or  a  Member,  elected  to  any  local
authority  under  the  provisions  of  the  Local  Authorities
Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262), which were in operation
on the date immediately preceding the date of coming into
operation of the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment)
Act, No. 22 of 2012, the provisions of the said Ordinance,
shall apply to and in relation to the filling of such vacancies,
notwithstanding the repealing or amendment of  the relevant
provisions by the Act, No. 22 of 2012:

column2: Provided  however  that,  where  a  vacancy  occurs  in  the

column1: office of Mayor in the circumstances specified in subsection
(4) of section 66B, inserted in the said Ordinance by the Act,
No. 22 of 2012, then the provisions of that subsection shall
apply in relation thereto.

column2: The provisions of this Act shall be in operation for a

column1: period  of  four  years  commencing  from  the  date  of
commencement of this Act.
